svg.title: Step 7 mockup 23: Scoring at the desk: screenshot, who played, tap to place, awards on the row, save
svg.text: 23 · Scoring at the desk: screenshot, who played, tap to place, awards on the row, save
Use case: the crew scores a session fast and enjoys it. A screenshot helps, three sources show who played, a tap places, a star gives an award, saving is a reveal. Demo names only.
Drop a file, paste, or take a photo on the crew phone
Read it with the AI reader
The picture goes to the provider set for the event. It finds
names, placements and game stats. A person checks everything.
Read: 4 names, 4 places, kills per player.
A wrong or faked picture would move the standings, so players
cannot add one. Typing by hand always works. The reader is off
until the organiser turns it on, with its consent notice.
Reg = registered · Voice = in the room · Shot = on the screenshot
Voice alone never decides. Nothing is final until Save.
The first time the crew links "N0VA_x" to Nova for this game, the next screenshot matches by itself.
3 · Tap to place, ⭐ for an award, name the teams
Tap a team or player: 1st, then 2nd … Tap ⭐ on a player row for an award.
The crew names the teams, for example to
fit the game. Team names show on the
match, the reveal and the results, never
4 · The standings update at once, then Save
Shown before saving, per person. It follows every tap and every award.
The hall screen shows the winners, then the awards, then
A later change is a correction with a reason.
Nothing counts until the crew saves. The reader and the sources only fill the form in.
Awards are given on the player row, in the same step as placements; one Save covers both.
In-game names are remembered per person and game: the name the crew linked matches the next screenshot.
The crew names the teams for each session; team names never enter the season standings.
